purpose: Teach: 各人/個々人/同国/番手/会期/座談/顔面/おこなう

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、各人の研究テーマを尊重しろ
lines.en: Ren — respect each person's research direction.
lines.style: Clear, measured instruction. Direct eye contact. No harshness, just the weight of expectation. Slight pause before the command word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。個々人の貢献を論文に反映します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure each person's contribution shows in the paper.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight forward lean. Taking the instruction seriously. Clean, clear delivery with no hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、同国出身研究者との情報交換を進めろ
lines.en: Ren — push forward with information exchange among researchers from the same region.
lines.style: Steady, purposeful. Another directive, but warmer than the first. The voice of someone who has thought about what Ren needs to learn.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文引用数の番手を意識します
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep track of citation rankings in the papers.
lines.style: Focused acknowledgment. Quick, steady delivery. Not rushed, but efficient. Shows he's already thinking about the practical weight of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会の会期中に発表せよ
lines.en: Ren — present your work during the conference period.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. This is a directive that matters. Slight emphasis on the action word. The tone of someone investing in Ren's growth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。座談会形式の研究会を企画します
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to organize it as a roundtable discussion session.
lines.style: Thoughtful, engaged response. Slower pace — he's already envisioning the format. Respectful but shows independent thinking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、被験者の顔面筋肉測定も学べ
lines.en: Ren — learn facial muscle measurement techniques from your subjects as well.
lines.style: Another instruction, this one with slight emphasis on 'as well.' Measured. The implication that there's depth to this work Ren hasn't yet grasped.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験はおこなう前に倫理審査を受けます
lines.en: Yes. We'll submit for ethics review before we run any experiments.
lines.style: Careful, methodical. Slight emphasis on the process. Shows responsibility without sounding defensive. Quiet conviction that this is the right way.
